title: Jagged Turkish Bulgur Icli Kofte
description: A traditional Turkish dish featuring red pepper paste, bulgur, and spices, wrapped in lotus leaves, this recipe is a jain-friendly, energizing meal option. It has a bitter and pillowy texture.

ingredients.name: spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, paprika, and salt

instructions: Rinse the bulgur and soak it in water for 30 minutes.
Heat the olive oil in a pan and saute the chopped onion until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the red pepper paste, spices, and salt, and stir well.
Add the soaked bulgur to the pan and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Add the lemon juice and stir well.
Prepare the lotus leaves by washing and cutting them into large squares.
Place a tablespoon of the bulgur mixture in the center of each lotus leaf square.
Fold the lotus leaf squares into triangles to enclose the filling.
Steam the wrapped kofte for 10 minutes.
Serve the jagged Turkish bulgur icli kofte hot.
